seg.seg_note: Two reportable segments; from 1Q23 the release lists MA before MIS. MA LOBs DS / R&I / D&I. In 2Q23 the company expanded DS disclosure into Banking / Insurance / KYC (10-Q revenue note; recorded in seg.legacy as 'DS: ...') and reclassified certain immaterial structured-finance-solutions revenue from DS to R&I, recasting prior periods (2Q23+ releases show restated 2022 DS/R&I comparatives; 1Q23 release comparatives are not restated). Segment Adjusted Operating Income = segment revenue incl. intersegment less Operating + SG&A (excludes D&A and restructuring). seg.legacy also holds the CFG/SFG/FIG/PPIF sub-lines.

The Company defines Free Cash Flow as net cash provided by operating activities minus cash paid for capital additions.
